title: Costroid per-PR tag set, version 0.1
description: The value of the FOCUS Tags column on a Costroid row. Every Costroid key carries the costroid/ prefix. Keys without the prefix are user-defined tags and pass through, except on the hosted ingest path, costroid serve, which drops them and counts them by name.

costroid/repo.description: The repository: host and path, no scheme. Maps to vcs.repository.url.full.

costroid/pr.description: The pull request or merge request number, as a string. Maps to vcs.change.id.

costroid/commit_sha.description: The head commit: 40 hexadecimal characters for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256, lower case. Maps to vcs.ref.head.revision.

costroid/workflow_run_id.description: The CI run. Maps to cicd.pipeline.run.id.

costroid/session_id.description: The agent session. Maps to gen_ai.conversation.id, with session.id as its alias.

costroid/agent.description: The agent, lower-case kebab: claude-code, codex, copilot, cursor, opencode. Maps to gen_ai.agent.name.

costroid/agent_version.description: The agent's own version string. Maps to gen_ai.agent.version.

costroid/model.description: The model that served the request. Maps to gen_ai.response.model, then gen_ai.request.model.

costroid/cost_source.description: What produced the figure. Open by design: agent_stream, agent_session_file, otlp and provider_report are defined here, and an adapter names itself.

allOf.description: A row whose run identity was not token-verified is unattributed.
An exact join names the repository, the pull request, the commit and the run.
A windowed join names the repository, because the repository is part of the join.

costBasis.description: What the figure is. One value for each accuracy label.

attributionGrade.description: How the row is joined to the pull request. A property of the join, not of the agent.

enforcementGrade.description: What held the run to its budget.

runIdentity.description: Whether the run identity was verified from the CI system's token.
